$comment: Every external host in the app's code (lib/, app/, mcp/, components/ and root files). "requests" are the hosts the app contacts and must match the README section "Your data stays yours" (see CONTRIBUTING, Outbound connections). "notRequested" hosts only appear as links or plain strings, and only in the files listed. lib/outbound-hosts.test.ts fails on anything else.

requests.accounts.google.com: Google sign-in: Auth.js OIDC discovery and the browser redirect (not a literal in our code)
requests.oauth2.googleapis.com: Google OAuth tokens (sign-in, refresh) and revoke on disconnect
requests.www.googleapis.com: Search Console and PageSpeed Insights APIs; also the OAuth scope names
requests.ssl.bing.com: Bing Webmaster Tools API, only with the user's own key
requests.api.dataforseo.com: DataForSEO API, only with the user's own key
requests.api.github.com: Daily update check (CRAWLSEO_UPDATE_CHECK=false turns it off)

github.com.reason: Link to a release page in the sidebar footer, opened by the user

crawlseo.cloud.reason: Info URL in the crawler User-Agent, and the sidebar card link
